newsitem.title: MEXICO: Geo places at 38.85 pesos per share.
newsitem.headline: Geo places at 38.85 pesos per share.

text.p: Mexican construction firm Corporacion Geo undertook a primary public offering on Tuesday at 38.75 pesos per share, the Mexican Stock Exchange (BMV) said.
A total of 1,950,135 B shares were issued in Mexico, a BMV statement said, which included a greenshoe allocation of 325,023 shares. The lead manager was the Bancomer brokerage.
An additional 11,846,150 series B shares were issued in the United States at a price of $4.87. The two placements accounted for 14.39 percent of Geo's shareholding equity, the BMV added.
Geo intends to use funds derived from the placements to acquire land, to increase its working capital and to expand its activities at the domestic and international level.
Geo shares ended trade on the BMV down 30 centavos at 40 pesos.
